header.generator: martsirt_v2_2/_tools/mk_placements_v22.py (v2.2 dressing pass on top of the v2.1 layout from mk_placements_v21.py; layout unchanged)
header.coordinates: three.js world, meters, Y up. +x = east, +z = south, -z = north (Briarwood road), town square centre at (0,0,0). pos = piece origin (GLB origin is base-centre of footprint at ground level). rotY = radians about +Y, applied as object.rotation.y. Unrotated GLBs face SOUTH (+z): their front door / main facade is on +z.
header.piece: GLB path relative to the sanctuary-assets repo root. v2.2 drop-in: every Martsirt piece lives under models/town/martsirt_v2_2/ (buildings, props, kit, materials/manifest.json); the Weeping Angel shrine is the repo copy models/shrines/shrine_weeping_angel.glb (unchanged). Shared materials: models/town/martsirt_v2_2/materials/manifest.json.
header.status: 'built' = GLB exists now (bytes given); 'planned' = placeholder, path reserved, engine should draw a grey box of `footprint` (buildings) or skip (props).

node_conventions.col_*: Invisible box colliders (static). Use mesh bounds as AABB/OBB; never render.
node_conventions.npc_spot_<role>: Empty; NPC stand/sit/work spot. Its -Z(glTF)/forward axis is facing; e.g. npc_spot_innkeeper, npc_spot_smith.
node_conventions.nav_entry_outside / nav_entry_inside / n: Empties either side of the main door for pathfinding enter/exit; other nav_* (nav_cellar_down, nav_upper_corridor) are interior waypoints.
node_conventions.fx_<type>_*: Empty marking an FX emitter: fx_fire, fx_embers, fx_smoke_chimney, fx_steam, fx_drip, fx_glow_window, fx_candle, fx_dust. Spawn particle system / point light at node transform; nothing in GLB lights.
node_conventions.sway_*: Rigid hanging object (lantern, sign iron) pivoting at node origin; drive small pendulum rotation.
node_conventions.cloth_* / banner: Cloth mesh; vertex attribute _pin (1 = pinned, 0 = free) for vertex-shader or cloth sim wind.
node_conventions.sign_*: Readable signboard (parent of the sign mesh, pivot at hinge); can also sway.
node_conventions.door_*: Door leaf with pivot at hinge for open/close.
node_conventions.ground_mud / ground_clutter / decals: Optional local mud apron, straw, stones and decals; engine may drop these if it has its own terrain.
node_conventions.win_glow_*: Thin emissive quad just inside a lit window or closed door (m_window_glow / _dim / _faint / _faint_glass, m_door_glow; emissiveFactor ~#ffb060 <= 1.0, extras.emissiveStrength 5 / 3.2 / 2.2 / 2.4, door 5 - set for the low fixed night ambient). extras.flicker=true -> modulate emissive intensity. Single-sided, faces out. Never collides. win_glow_door_main sits 3 cm behind the closed door leaf (inn, forge) and fills the opening when door_* swings.
node_conventions.fx_glow_window_*: Empty 0.3 m outside a lit window: spawn a warm point light. extras: color, intensity (0-1 relative), distance, flicker.
node_conventions.fx_glow_door_*: Empty just outside an open doorway (inn, forge): warm spill light. extras: color, intensity, distance, flicker.
node_conventions.fx_fire_torch_*: Empty at the flame of a wall torch (iron bracket + haft + emissive m_torch_flame, built into the building GLB): small flickering point light + flame/smoke fx. extras kind=torch.
node_conventions.fx_fire_bonfire_main: Main town bonfire (props/prop_bonfire_main.glb): big warm flickering light (extras distance 18) + flame fx; fx_embers = ember/spark emitter; fx_smoke_bonfire, fx_sparks_bonfire = optional fx.
node_conventions.fx_fire_campfire: Small campfire (props/prop_campfire.glb): smaller flickering light (extras distance 7); fx_embers_campfire, fx_smoke_campfire optional.
node_conventions.dressing: kind "dressing": merged town-space GLBs under models/town/martsirt_v2_2/dressing/, each placed ONCE at pos (0,0,0), rotY 0, scale 1 - geometry is already in town metres (exception to "origin at base center"). One primitive per material: dress_trees (m_dress_atlas bark + m_dress_foliage leaves), dress_rocks, dress_fences, dress_graveyard (m_dress_atlas), dress_clutter (m_dress_atlas + m_roof_thatch), creek (water_creek = m_water_creek, creek_banks = m_dress_atlas, creek_reeds = m_dress_foliage).
node_conventions.water_creek: Creek water ribbon (m_water_creek). Flow direction in UV: glTF v increases downstream, 1 v-unit = 2 m; u 0..1 across. Scroll the normal map along +v at manifest flow_speed_m_s (0.35 m/s = 0.175 v/s). Never collides; tiles are in world json water[].
node_conventions.m_dress_foliage: alphaMode MASK, alphaCutoff 0.5, doubleSided (leaf / bough / reed cards; baseColor png alpha).

v2.note: MARTSIRT v2.1 - Brian: "We dont need the markets. Maybe a single market... spread the buildings out a bit. Think of diablo 1 town tristram." Town re-laid as a loose, organic cluster around the square and well at ~0.875 of v1 spacing (v2.0 was 0.75): every building hand-placed off-grid with an extra skew, uneven gaps and winding lanes. One market stall (tallow) kept beside the square; other stalls, the market cart and crates removed. All lamp posts / lantern poles removed (incl. the 4 built into the square and the inn yard pole); light now comes from window glow, door glow (inn, forge), 5 wall torches (gatehouse x2, chapel door, inn door, forge door), the forge fire, built-in braziers (gatehouse, watch-house), one main bonfire and one campfire. Inn and forge dirt aprons shrunk to 0.55 (ground decals only; building size unchanged) and the buildings separated so the aprons no longer merge.

v22_dressing.note: MARTSIRT v2.2 dressing pass - Brian: "Ours feels empty ... Trees, some rocks of different sizes, a little vein river etc. ... Just dont overdo it, less is more." Layout, roads, gates, buildings, the Weeping Angel, the single market stall, bonfire and campfire are unchanged from v2.1. Added: 17 trees (4 variants), 24 rocks (5 variants), an 86 m creek with pebble banks, reeds, a plank footbridge on the forge road and a culvert under the NW palisade, 3 short broken fence runs, 7 grave markers + a broken wall stub east of the graveyard, and 7 clutter items. The 12 single dead-tree props (dead_tree_0..11) are removed - the merged tree GLB replaces them.
